NZL.note: Milk powder (HS 0402) basis. WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: NZ exported 1,843 kt of milk/concentrated cream (0402) worth $5.94bn; the world's #1 milk-powder exporter (mostly WMP). Raw milk output ~21 Mt (USDA PSD).

USA.note: Milk powder basis (SMP/NFDM dominant). USDA PSD 2024: 0402-specific exports ~380 kt led by Mexico and SE Asia. WITS confirms large US shipments to Indonesia (50.6 kt) and Philippines (83.9 kt).

DEU.note: Milk powder basis. Germany is a major EU milk-powder producer/exporter; much trade is intra-EU. 0402-equivalent estimate from USDA PSD/Eurostat EU dairy balance.

NLD.note: Milk powder basis. Netherlands is a leading EU dairy exporter (FrieslandCampina hub) with a large re-export role. 0402-equivalent from Eurostat/USDA. WITS 2024: NLD→China 20.1 kt.

FRA.note: Milk powder basis. France is a top EU producer of milk powder and infant formula (Lactalis, Sodiaal). 0402-equivalent from Eurostat/USDA; much value-add is in HS 1901 infant formula, not 0402.

IRL.note: Milk powder basis. Ireland is strongly export-oriented (Glanbia/Tirlan, Kerry, Ornua). 0402-equivalent from Eurostat/USDA. WITS 2024: IRL→Philippines 7.5 kt.

AUS.note: Milk powder basis. WITS 2024: Australia exported ~150 kt of 0402, incl. China 55.1 kt and Indonesia 45.1 kt. Output declining with a falling milk pool.

BLR.note: Milk powder basis. Belarus is a significant powder exporter, primarily to Russia and CIS, plus China (WITS 2024: BLR→China 9.0 kt). Partial Comtrade non-reporter; figures lean on partner/USDA data.

ARG.note: Milk powder basis. Argentina is a Mercosur WMP exporter (Brazil, Algeria, regional). 0402-equivalent from USDA PSD.

URY.note: Milk powder basis. Uruguay (Conaprole) is an export-heavy WMP producer serving Brazil, Algeria, Mexico. 0402-equivalent from USDA PSD.

CHN.note: Milk powder basis. WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: China imported 656.8 kt of 0402 worth $2.36bn, the world's largest buyer; NZ supplied 524.1 kt (80%). WMP imports fell ~10% vs 2023.

DZA.note: Milk powder basis. Algeria is a partial Comtrade non-reporter; figure built from partner-mirror (NZ→DZA 147.3 kt WITS 2024) plus USDA which ranks Algeria a top-3 global milk-powder importer (state ONIL tenders, ~400 kt).

IDN.note: Milk powder basis. WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: Indonesia imported 298.8 kt of 0402 ($847M); NZ 150.6 kt, USA 50.6 kt, Australia 45.1 kt. Also re-exports repacked powder (IDN→Philippines 54.4 kt).

MEX.note: Milk powder basis. WITS 2024 reported Mexico's 0402 imports by value ($1.01bn) but withheld the USA quantity; tonnage modeled from value at ~$3,200/t NFDM ⇒ ~315 kt, ~98% from the USA.

PHL.note: Milk powder basis. WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: Philippines imported 266.6 kt of 0402 ($607M); USA 83.9 kt, NZ 43.5 kt, Indonesia 54.4 kt. Imports surged ~25% in 2024.

SAU.note: Milk powder basis. Major Gulf powder importer for recombination (Almarai, SADAFCO). WITS 2024 NZ mirror: NZ→Saudi 70.4 kt; total ~110 kt across NZ/EU.

BGD.note: Milk powder basis. Bangladesh recombines imported powder into liquid milk. WITS 2024 NZ mirror: NZ→Bangladesh 68.7 kt; total ~120-130 kt (USDA).

NGA.note: Milk powder basis. Nigeria imports powder for recombination (FrieslandCampina WAMCO). WITS 2024 NZ mirror: NZ→Nigeria 33.1 kt; EU and Argentina supply the balance; total ~70-80 kt.

RUS.note: Milk powder basis. Russia is a net powder importer sourcing chiefly from Belarus. 0402-equivalent from USDA PSD; Russia is a Comtrade non-reporter for recent years.

LKA.note: Milk powder basis. Sri Lanka is highly powder-import-dependent (Anchor/Fonterra). WITS 2024 NZ mirror: NZ→Sri Lanka 56.7 kt; total ~85-90 kt.

ARE.note: Milk powder basis. The UAE is a Gulf import-and-reexport hub. WITS 2024 NZ mirror: NZ→UAE 100.4 kt; re-exports significant powder onward to MENA/Africa.

MYS.note: Milk powder basis. Malaysia imports and re-exports repacked/recombined powder across SE Asia. WITS 2024 NZ mirror: NZ→Malaysia 95.2 kt; also exports (MYS→Indonesia 18.3, →Philippines 14.7 kt).

BRA.note: Milk powder basis. Brazil imports WMP mostly from Mercosur (Argentina, Uruguay) to cover deficits. 0402-equivalent from USDA PSD.

rankings.note: Milk powder (HS 0402) basis, kt. NZL exporter value from WITS 2024 exporter-reported (1,843 kt); EU/USA/AUS/BLR/ARG/URY are 0402-equivalent estimates blending WITS extra-EU flows with USDA PSD (much EU powder trade is intra-EU). Importers CHN/IDN/PHL/MEX from WITS importer-reported; DZA/SAU/ARE/BGD/MYS from NZ mirror + USDA; RUS from USDA. Cheese (0406) and butter (0405) excluded.

companies.name: Fonterra
companies.metric: World's largest dairy exporter; NZ farmer co-op processing ~80% of NZ milk; revenue ~NZ$24bn (FY2024).
companies.note: Anchor/Anlene brands; the single biggest supplier behind the NZL→China and SE-Asia powder flows.
companies.improve: Should publish destination-country powder volumes and emissions intensity per product so its dominance of milk-powder trade is transparent.

companies.name: Lactalis
companies.metric: World's largest dairy company by revenue (~EUR 30bn, private); major milk-powder and infant-formula producer.
companies.note: President, Galbani, Parmalat brands; large EU 0402 and HS 1901 infant-formula output.
companies.improve: Private; should disclose powder export volumes by origin and destination.

companies.name: Nestle
companies.metric: Group revenue ~CHF 91bn (FY2024); major buyer/processor of milk powder for infant formula, Nido, Coffee-mate.
companies.note: A key driver of global powder demand, especially in emerging markets.
companies.improve: Should report milk-powder procurement volumes by source country.

companies.name: FrieslandCampina
companies.metric: Dutch farmer co-op; ~EUR 13bn revenue (FY2024); leading EU milk-powder and recombined-milk player.
companies.note: Operates WAMCO in Nigeria and Frisian Flag in Indonesia, directly behind NLD/EU→Nigeria and →Indonesia powder flows.
companies.improve: Should break out recombined-milk powder volumes by destination market.

companies.name: Danone
companies.metric: Revenue ~EUR 27bn (FY2024); top global infant-nutrition (Aptamil/Nutrilon) and dairy player.
companies.note: Large consumer of SMP/WMP and whey, especially in China-facing formula.
companies.improve: Should disclose powder sourcing by origin given China-formula exposure.

companies.name: Arla Foods
companies.metric: Danish-Swedish farmer co-op; ~EUR 13.8bn revenue (FY2024); major European powder/butter/cheese exporter.
companies.note: Lurpak, Arla, Milex powders serving MENA, Africa and Asia.
companies.improve: Should publish powder export tonnage by destination region.

global.note: Global milk powder (WMP+SMP/NFDM, HS 0402 plus dairy powders), kt. Production/consumption are combined WMP+SMP; exports are world milk-powder export volume (~4.8-4.9 Mt/yr; NZ ~1.8 Mt of that). USDA PSD Dairy 2024, rounded. World 0402-only trade (excluding powders under 0404/1901) is somewhat lower.

forecast.method: OECD-FAO Agricultural Outlook envelope; 2030=2024×(1+rate)^6. Powder demand growth led by SE Asia, MENA and Africa; NZ/EU supply growth constrained by environmental limits on herd size.
